$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). Add actorId after the first deploy creates the actor, so CI updates it by ID and a rename of name in actor.json keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Foundit Jobs Scraper - Monster India & Gulf Jobs
seoDescription: Scrape foundit.in, founditgulf.com and seven more foundit sites: job titles, companies, years of experience, skills, pay and posting dates. No login.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 1 GB, proposed from local runs on 2026-11-08 (apify run, engine from the platform/foundit worktree, memory and CPU read inside the actor's own process); measure on Apify before publishing. Searches peaked at 77-131 MB and used 0.4-6.7 s of CPU; every job of all nine sites (72,668 rows, 764 calls) peaked at 300 MB with 52 s of CPU in 417 s. Runs wait on foundit's pace of about 2 calls a second, not on CPU, so 512 MB (minMemoryMbytes) may be as fast for searches: run the example and the empty form at 512 MB and 1 GB on Apify and take 512 MB if the times match. 1 GB keeps a quarter core for the every-job run's 52 s of CPU. timeoutSecs 1800: the every-job run took 7 minutes.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-08, round 2 (BRIEF-2.md): apply is false for the first deploy, so the measuring runs on Apify run unpriced and cost only the platform's usage. The prices below are round 1's house-rule prices (rules/SEO.md section 16, anchored on themineworks/foundit-jobs-scraper, the most used actor made only for Foundit, 186 u30: $0.0025 a job on FREE, $0.002 BRONZE, $0.00175 SILVER, $0.0015 GOLD and above, no start fee). They are replaced by the tiered prices computed from those runs (owner's markup ladder, BRIEF-2.md section 4), which then go in as the Actor's first pricing with apply true. isPublic stays false until the owner's final check.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, location, years of experience, skills, pay when shown, posting date, country site, listing source and job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, every place with its state and country, the qualifications asked for and pay as numbers.
